name: Cho'Gath
title: The Terror of the Void

passive.name: Carnivore

description.normalized: Killing an enemy restores 16 (+ 2 x level) Health and 4 (+0.35 x level) Mana. The values restored are doubled if the unit is a champion, turret, or epic monster.

passive.rawParsedText:
Killing an enemy restores 16 (+ 2 x level) Health and 4 (+0.35 x level) Mana.

The values restored are doubled if the unit is a champion, turret, or epic monster.

q.name: Rupture

description.normalized: Ruptures the ground, knocking up enemies for 1 second, dealing 80 / 135 / 190 / 245 (+100% AP) magic damage and slowing them by 60% for 1.5 seconds.

q.rawParsedText: Ruptures the ground, knocking up enemies for 1 second, dealing 80 / 135 / 190 / 245 (+100% AP) magic damage and slowing them by 60% for 1.5 seconds.

w.name: Feral Scream

description.normalized: Roars, silencing enemies in an area for 1.4 / 1.6 / 1.8 / 2 seconds and dealing 80 / 130 / 180 / 230 (+70% AP) magic damage.

w.rawParsedText: Roars, silencing enemies in an area for 1.4 / 1.6 / 1.8 / 2 seconds and dealing 80 / 130 / 180 / 230 (+70% AP) magic damage.

e.name: Vorpal Spikes

description.normalized: Cho'Gath's next 3 attacks launch spikes that: Deal 20 / 45 / 70 / 95 (+30% AP) magic damage plus magic damage equal to 2.3% / 2.7% / 3.1% / 3.5% (+0.6% x Feast stacks) x the target's max Health and slows by 30% / 35% / 40% / 45% decaying over 1.5 seconds. Vorpal Spikes width increases with Cho'Gath's size. Base damage against minions and monsters is capped at 100 (30% AP) magic damage.

Vorpal Spikes width increases with Cho'Gath's size.

Base damage against minions and monsters is capped at 100 (30% AP) magic damage.

r.name: Feast

description.normalized: Devours an enemy, dealing: 300 / 450 / 600 (+50% AP +8% of Cho'Gath's bonus Health) true damage to champions; Deals 1200 (+50% AP + 10% of Cho'Gath's bonus Health) true damage to minions and monsters. If this kills the target, Cho'Gath gains 1 stack of Feast. Stacks gained from minions and non-epic monsters are capped at 6. Feast (per stack): Grants 80 / 120 / 160 max Health; Increases size by 6%, up to an increase of 135%; Increases Attack Range by 4.7 / 6.2 / 7.7, up to an increase of 75; Increases this ability's cast range by 2.5, up to an increase of 25.
